title: Data enrichment loop Round 1: shipyards & dry docks (entity type + global directory)
description: Add a new `shipyard` entity type to the DataYacht knowledge graph and populate it with a researched global directory of dry docks and refit/repair facilities — superyacht builder yards (Feadship, Azimut-Benetti, Lürssen, Oceanco, Damen/Amels...), independent refit specialists (MB92, Lusben, Palumbo, Rybovich...), and commercial dry docks per country. Pipeline: research agents produce curated markdown tables → new knowledge/*.md docs → new shipyardMapper in ingest → graph.json → app. Also adds a completeness-score reporter so each enrichment round is measured against the ≥8.5/10 goal (standing authorization from human: full autonomous loop, commercial dry docks in scope).
acceptance_criteria: A shipyardMapper exists in ingest/src/mappers with a schema guard that routes shipyard tables (columns: Shipyard, Country, City, Operator, Facility Type, Dry Docks, Max LOA (m), Max Tonnage (t), Dock Dimensions, Lift Type, Services, Founded, Website, Notes) and is wired into ingest.js routing precedence with tests
New OPERATED_BY edges (shipyard->company/builder) and LOCATED_IN edges (shipyard->region) are produced by the mapper
At least 150 shipyard/dry-dock facilities across at least 15 countries are ingested from new curated knowledge docs, each with provenance
A completeness-score reporter (node script) computes per-type and overall weighted scores from graph.json and is committed
npm test green in ingest/ and app/; graph.json re-exported and synced; app renders the new shipyard type without errors

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: CLOSED on green review. Delivery: shipyardMapper (guard-, mapper-, and routing-level tests), completeness scorer (npm run score), app-side shipyard registration, knowledge/83-87 corpus docs. Graph: 3357→3946 nodes (shipyard 236 across 53 countries), 1823→2303 edges (operated_by 232). Score 4.40→5.79. Review round 1: BLOCK (HIGH comma-tonnage corruption ~43 facilities; 3 MEDIUM; 2 LOW) — all fixed, +6 regression tests, junk operator nodes replaced (rheinmetall/next-yacht-group/vigor-industrial). Review round 2: APPROVE, all ACs explicitly met, ingestion-order invariant locked by baseline tests. Carry-forwards to TASK-017: (1) Norfolk Naval Shipyard tonnage cell is prose → parses as 8t (knowledge/86:83) — curate; (2) reviewer recommends range-sanity locks on real corpus (max_tonnage ∈ [100, 1.5M], max_loa ∈ [10, 700]); (3) companyMapper kind='yacht services' for the 27 service companies; (4) scorer measures presence not correctness — noted, not a defect.
